linkIconDescription: Smart Fill keeps curated and custom Link Icon graphics and replaces only its generic web placeholder. Auto Favicon Priority prefers a retrieved favicon.
monogramColorDescription: Use stable colors derived from each domain, or choose one custom gradient for generated letter icons.
monogramPrimaryDescription: Start color used by the custom global gradient and new domain overrides.
monogramSecondaryDescription: End color used by the custom global gradient and new domain overrides.
monogramTextDescription: Text color used by generated letter icons.
monogramShapeDescription: Default shape for generated letter icons.
monogramOverridesDescription: Optionally assign a letter, colors, and shape to a domain. These settings apply only when no real favicon is available.
enableDescription: Display a favicon before external links. Network access occurs only when a domain is not cached.
strategyDescription: Standard: website + selected service, without Google/DDG. Proxy: adds Google/DDG. Direct: target website only, with a local fallback.
providerDescription: Automatic tries FaviconKit and favicon.im. You can also select one provider. Direct Website Only ignores this setting.
customProviderDescription: Used only with Custom service. Insert {domain} where the domain belongs, for example https://example.com/favicon/{domain}.
fallbackDescription: A colorful monogram is generated locally so unavailable or uncommon websites still have a visual marker.
sizeDescription: Size relative to surrounding text. Recommended: 0.9–1.2.
cacheDaysDescription: Icons are retrieved again after expiration. Enter 0 to cache forever.
cacheDescription: Cached icons are loaded locally first. Icon files are stored in workspace/data/public/auto-favicon/.
clearCacheConfirm: This deletes automatically retrieved and generated cache entries but keeps pinned custom icons. Nothing is retrieved again immediately. Continue?
refreshAllConfirm: This retrieves every automatically cached domain again; pinned custom icons are unchanged. It may take some time. Continue?
cacheNoMatches: No cached domains match the search
customIconInvalid: No valid image could be read from that file or URL
customIconSaveFailed: Could not save the custom icon
loadingCustomUrl: Retrieving and validating the image URL…
noCandidates: No usable icon candidates were found
candidateCount: {count} usable icon candidates found. Click one to select it.
noCurrentDomains: The current document has no web links with icons to retrieve
refreshFinished: Refresh finished: {success} succeeded, {failed} failed, {skipped} pinned icons skipped
noRefreshableDomains: Only pinned custom icons remain; there are no domains to refresh
cacheCleared: Automatic icon cache cleared; pinned custom icons were kept
